title: Love, Pax’s single “Count On Me” is a soulful promise covered in melody
htmlContent: Love, Pax’s debut single, “Count On Me,” offers a soothing sense of comfort and a hand reaching out in the dark. This is the first solo release from singer-songwriter James Paxton, who previously worked with groups like Soundaze and Flamingo Dogs. In this new song, he steps away from the alt-hip-hop style of his past and embraces a more intimate sound, blending soft folk melodies that remind listeners of artists like José Gonzalez, Iron & Wine, and Elliott Smith. “Count On Me” was recorded and produced with Nikolas Thompson at Breathing Rhythm Studio in Norman, OK. This track marks a significant shift in Paxton’s music, presenting a personal side that feels genuine. https://open.spotify.com/track/27NmcEMZQ8n0ihHyn2X3mT He creates a warm and intimate atmosphere with gentle guitar melodies and soft singing. There’s a sincere look at love and trust wrapped in melodies that stick with you. It encourages you to pause, close your eyes, and feel its heartfelt message. As the beginning of his new artistic journey, Love, Pax introduces a refreshing sense of honesty and elegance. Follow on: Facebook/Instagram
